recognize_zh: 原始細胞胞質與核上布滿粗大、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，部分覆蓋核而使核輪廓模糊，旁邊還有無顆粒、染色質細緻的原始細胞；高倍圖可見顆粒脫出於細胞邊緣（箭頭），符合急性嗜鹼性球白血病。
features: Medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin partially obscured by coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules overlying the nucleus and cytoplasm
Coexisting agranular blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and a rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm
Granules unevenly distributed, with focal degranulation/extrusion at the cell margin and a cytoplasmic protrusion (arrow, panel B)
Absence of mature segmented basophils in the field; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Smear shows blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, many of which contain numerous coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules overlying both nucleus and cytoplasm, together with agranular blasts with scant pale basophilic cytoplasm. At high power, granules appear clustered at the cell periphery with focal extrusion from a cytoplasmic protrusion. Mature basophils and eosinophils are not prominent. Findings are suggestive of acute basophilic leukemia; confirmation requires metachromatic staining (toluidine blue positive), negative MPO, flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD11b; CD117 negative) and exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and other defining genetic lesions.

ddx.vs: Mast cells also show metachromatic granules but are CD117-bright, tryptase-positive and CD25-positive, with oval nuclei and more evenly distributed granules.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia
ddx.vs: CML blast phase with basophilia arises with a chronic-phase history and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
APL granules are azurophilic (red-purple), MPO strongly positive with Auer rod bundles, and the cells carry PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) or t(6;9) with basophilia
ddx.vs: These AML types have basophilia accompanying other blasts with specific cytogenetics, so karyotype is required to exclude them.
